title: The Best Resume Hard Skills for 2024
description:
What are resume hard skills exactly? And how do you make sure you’re highlighting the right ones to stand out in a competitive job market? Resume hard skills are clear, quantifiable representations of what you’re professionally capable of.

In this video, we’ll dive into how to tell what hard skills to include on your resume so you leave a lasting impression. (And show you how to add those to your resume using Teal’s AI Resume Builder!)

Read more here: https://www.tealhq.com/post/hard-skills-resume
